title: Resource close order and suppressed exceptions
summary: Reversing resource acquisition changes the primary or suppressed tags while every tagged failure has the same exception class.

subject.system: Resource close order and suppressed exceptions

change.description: Reversing resource acquisition changes the primary or suppressed tags while every tagged failure has the same exception class.

notes: The independent JVM oracle covered 8 inputs on each revision. original mismatches were 0 for primary, 0 for suppressed, 0 for close. nested mismatches were 0 for primary, 0 for suppressed, 0 for close. reversed mismatches were 1 for primary, 2 for suppressed, 8 for close.

The first batch could not bind the mask argument to the integer named code in the frozen guard. The corrected adapter exposes that name. Both original JVM calibrations, the refused executions and the fresh-classloader results remain separate.
